rationale: The Agent Mode guide specifies Platform 10.1.x+, assistant 2.1.0+ for the stated path, listed AWS service regions and enabled Model Runtime. The Cloud Connected installation guide and SAIA-9918 exclude Enterprise Cloud Connected in 2.2.0–2.3.6. The 2.1.1 workaround has no Agent Mode and 2.4.0 is planned with fresh setup. The feature guide separately addresses certificate and network requirements. Runtime uses hosted or third-party models, with Global and Data zone routing qualifications. Limited IL2 base-assistant guidance excludes Agent Mode in its stated scope.
